title: In-tree CLI is authoritative for generated documentation
context: Two decision-graph corrections were made via a globally-installed hunch MCP server, which regenerated documentation files. However, the global server reintroduced a record-counts sentence (#68) that had previously been intentionally removed, creating divergence between what the global tool generates and what the in-tree CLI produces.
decision: Documentation regeneration must use the in-tree CLI, not external/globally-installed tools. Committed docs are grounded in the checkout's own generator, not external systems.
consequences: Auto-generated docs stay consistent with in-tree tooling output
Prevents divergence between global and local generators from propagating into committed artifacts
Requires workflow discipline: regenerate with in-tree CLI after any record updates
alternatives_rejected: Manually maintain generated docs (defeats purpose of automation)
Sync global server to match in-tree output (doesn't prevent future divergence)
